title: safeWrapAsync
summary: Normalize asynchronous work into a data-or-error result.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: work is a callback returning a value or promise.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Promise<Result<T>> with data on success or error on failure.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Returning an Error is treated as failure. Rejected promises and synchronous exceptions are converted to Error values whose cause preserves the original failure. This is an exported low-level utility used by the router and server dispatcher.
